seoDescription: Cut through the noise. Reconnect with what actually matters and design a life that feels like your own — not one you inherited or performed.

hero.title: Clarity & Purpose
hero.summary: Cut through the noise. Reconnect with what actually matters and design a life that feels like your own — not one you inherited or performed.

items.title: Cut Through the Noise
items.description: Separate what's actually yours from what you've inherited, absorbed, or performed for others.

items.title: Reconnect With What Matters
items.description: Get honest about your values and priorities, and let them guide your next decisions.

items.title: Design a Real Plan
items.description: Turn clarity into a concrete direction — one you can actually act on, not just think about.

items.title: Live It Out Loud
items.description: Build a life and routine that reflect who you are now, not who you used to be.

checklist.sectionTitle: This Is For You If You...
items: Feel unsure what you actually want
Keep chasing goals that don't feel like yours
Are tired of living on autopilot
Want a life that feels aligned, not performed

image.alt: Reflective moment representing clarity and purpose work

quote.quote: Clarity doesn't arrive from thinking harder. It arrives from getting honest.
